notes: A zero row at the bill stage. The 2026 PSIP prints 18,704 thousand of foreign loans and 339,794 thousand of foreign grants for central government, and the project pages foot to both: solid waste (the loan), housing, the coast guard kitchen, marine police facilities, an indoor sports court and elderly homes (the grants). The digital programmes print no financing split and are Consolidated Fund money.
